evidence.text: PKP CARGO's Q2 2026 ton-km looks to be up about +19% YoY, from about +10% in Q1. The cumulative headlines read as falling share (mass share YTD 27.84% after March, 27.13% after June), and that masks the Q2 year-on-year gain. Derived from UTK cumulative shares times market totals: Q2 2026 about 3.96bn tkm against about 3.34bn in Q2 2025, and Q2 mass share about 26.5% against about 25.1%. The Q2 2025 EBITDA base it lands on is weak at 65.4m PLN (H1 140.2m less Q1 74.8m).
evidence.reaction_history_on_this_line: No clean precedent on an EBITDA surprise. H1 2025 was +7.33% on 2025-10-01 on a net-profit headline. FY2025 was +4.41% on 2026-04-29. Q3 2025 was about 0% on 2025-12-01. Q1 2026 was -14.19% on 2026-06-01, confounded because debt-to-equity conversion and a rights issue at 12 PLN were announced the same evening.
evidence.why_not_priced: Each monthly PAP wire reports a cumulative share that has fallen month after month since March. It is never de-cumulated into a quarterly volume, so the Q2 acceleration shows up in no headline. With one analyst and no published estimate there is no consensus EBITDA to carry it. If it were priced, the stock would not sit 13% below the 12 PLN rights-issue floor with a -3.5% 20-day drift into the print. That said, the drawdown is more plausibly dilution than operations, which is why this is sized small.
evidence.independence: Same UTK series from different PAP months. Mass after March 2026 was 27.65% (revised to 27.84%) against 26.91%, and ton-km 28.31% against 25.93%: https://www.bankier.pl/wiadomosc/Udzial-PKP-Cargo-w-rynku-przewiezionych-towarow-wg-masy-wzrosl-rdr-po-III-do-27-65-proc-UTK-9125670.html. Market totals for H1 2026 (107.4mt, +2.3%): https://www.rynek-kolejowy.pl/wiadomosci/przewozy-towarowe-czwarty-z-rzedu-miesiac-poprawy-polrocze-na-plusie-153927.html. Against it: the company's own Q1 form shows revenue of 924.7m against 939.6m on about +10% ton-km (https://www.bankier.pl/wiadomosc/PKP-CARGO-S-A-W-RESTRUKTURYZACJI-Wyniki-finansowe-QSr-1-2026-9142747.html). Volume is being bought with price, and that is why the size is cut.

evidence.text: The H1 2026 net result will be compared against an H1 2025 figure (-17.9m PLN) that contained a Q2 2025 net profit of +30.7m. StockWatch attributed that profit mainly to a reversal of write-downs (odwrócenie odpisów). With Q1 2026 already at -45.8m, H1 2026 matches last year only if Q2 2026 nets more than about +28m, so the likely wire headline is a wider half-year loss. That would also sit awkwardly against the strategy's line that the group returns to net profit in 2026.
evidence.reaction_history_on_this_line: The last time the net headline surprised was H1 2025: the one-off-driven Q2 profit printed and the stock rose +7.33% on 2025-10-01 on 354k shares, against about 30k typical. So this name has reacted to the headline net number rather than to its quality.
evidence.why_not_priced: Nobody publishes an H1 net estimate for this name: the baseline shows 1 analyst and a null estimate. The prior-year one-off is a year-old footnote, not something a wire comparison adjusts for. If the market had already framed H1 2026 against a clean base, there would be sell-side or press previews saying so, and I found none. Still, Q1's -45.8m is public and the stock is at 52-week lows, so a good part of 'still loss-making' is already in the price. Hence the small size.
evidence.independence: H1 2025 figures (EBIT 54.7m, net -17.9m, Q2 net +30.7m) from a different outlet: https://kolejowyportal.pl/grupa-pkp-cargo-przedstawila-wyniki-za-i-polrocze-2025-roku/. Q1 2026 net -45.8m: https://kolejowyportal.pl/pkp-cargo-podsumowalo-pierwszy-kwartal-2026-roku/. The strategy line on net profitability in 2026: https://www.pkpcargo.com/raporty_biezace/zatwierdzenie-przez-rade-nadzorcza-strategii-restrukturyzacyjnej-grupy-kapitalowej-pkp-cargo-na-lata-2025-2031/. This does not contradict finding 1: EBITDA can rise year on year while net falls against a base that one-off reversals flattered.

evidence.text: The creditors' council's opinion on the 15 September arrangement proposals, and the deadline for competing proposals from parties other than PKP CARGO or the administrator, both fall on 2026-10-15. The creditor vote follows. This is the event that actually sets the equity's fate.

Series N rights issue of 75.0-89.6m shares at the higher of 12.00 PLN or 80% of the 50-session VWAP ending 2026-12-16. That floor is above today's 10.42 spot, so on current prices the rights are out of the money. Add 29.4m series D shares converting Group IV state-railway claims at 12 PLN (44.8m -> 74.2m shares before N) and warrants letting PKP S.A. hold 25-33.34%. The dilution is known and was announced on 2026-05-29/06-23.

The PLN 1.52bn 'coal decision' damages claim against the State Treasury. The regional court resumed it and suspended it again on 2026-09-15 for settlement talks, and the 15/09 proposals hand 50% of any net recovery to creditor groups I, III and IV. It is undated and, as a contingent asset, will not appear in the H1 balance sheet.

first_hunter_context.session_check: amc. The company's own investor page says 'Financial results are published after market close' and lists 'September 28, 2026 2026 First-Half Financial Update and Statements' (https://www.ose-immuno.com/en/investors-2/). The French page carries '28 septembre 2026 Résultats financiers du 1er semestre 2026' (https://www.ose-immuno.com/fr/investisseurs/), and so does the AMF-filed 2026 calendar of 2026-03-16 (https://fr.ftp.opendatasoft.com/datadila/INFOFI/MKW/2026/03/FCMKW130028_20260316.pdf). Past practice is mixed, which is why the date carries risk: FY2025 was calendared for 29 April and came out 30 April at 07:30 CEST (bmo, still inside an amc-28 window if the same thing happens), the audited FY followed on 3 June at 20:00 CET, and the H1 2025 results slipped to 15 Oct 2025 at 19:00 CEST. The calendar is 'donné à titre indicatif, sous réserve de modifications', so there is a slip risk I put at about 20-25%.

evidence.text: The runway the market was last given (end-December 2026, 3 June) assumed about EUR 19.3m of IRIS proceeds priced at the EUR 4.83 VWAP. With spot at EUR 2.31, the 2,735,000 warrants left after 1,265,000 shares were issued in June-August are worth only about EUR 6m at the 5% discount. The URD also schedules a EUR 7m EIB repayment for July 2026 and says about EUR 15m more is needed for a 12-month runway. So the H1 release's cash-at-30-June and runway/going-concern language is more likely to shorten, or to be made conditional on a new financing, than to reaffirm.
evidence.reaction_history_on_this_line: Price moves after this name's financial and funding releases (Yahoo OSE.PA daily closes): H1 2025 results (15 Oct 2025, amc) -7.5% the next day; H1 2025 cash position (25 Sep 2025, amc) -1.8%; FY2025 unaudited plus Q1 cash and 'runway until early Q4 2026' (30 Apr 2026, bmo) -3.3%; IRIS bridge (28 May 2026, amc) -7.9% the next day, then -4.6% and -8.5%; audited FY with 'runway end-December 2026' (3 Jun 2026, amc) +0.1%. Funding news has been sold every time but once.
evidence.why_not_priced: Mostly priced, and that is why it is small. If the market had fully priced a going-concern cliff, the IRIS shares would not still be absorbing near 5% discounts and the stock would trade nearer cash; it is on an all-time low but still well above that. What has NOT been published is the 30 June cash figure. The company has put out no Q2 cash position, and its calendar has no such date. Nor has it said whether the July EIB tranche was repaid or rescheduled: the AMF flux shows no EIB filing since June. The runway re-statement that follows from those numbers is also unpublished. The sign is genuinely open, because a larger raise with specialist funds that ends the IRIS overhang could be taken as relief (Biomed Impact, 29 May: 'une levée de fonds significative avec des fonds de qualité peut induire un regain de confiance'). Hence the wide band on both sides.
evidence.independence: Same document family as the company releases (URD, AMF filings, IRIS release), so no independent confirmation of the numbers. A different source agrees that refinancing is the central open question: Biomed Impact, 3 Sep 2026, 'Le titre devrait réagir positivement mais de façon modérée en raison du sujet de refinancement qui reste central sur le dossier' (The stock should react positively but moderately, because refinancing remains the central issue) — https://www.biomed-impact.com/post/commentaire-ose-immuno-03-09-2026 — and on 29 May it expected 'un montage plus conséquent d'ici 3-6 mois' (a larger financing within 3-6 months) — https://www.biomed-impact.com/post/commentaire-ose-immuno-29-05-2026.

evidence.text: The ARTEMIA Phase 3 interim futility analysis was guided to Q3 2026, but the same release put the next IDMC review in October 2026. Nothing has been filed by 25 Sep, so the H1 release's milestone section will most likely move this key catalyst into Q4. That makes it a small guidance-timing negative inside the window; the binary outcome itself sits outside it.
evidence.reaction_history_on_this_line: No clean prior re-dating of an ARTEMIA milestone to measure. The nearest pipeline-reset release, the 2 Mar 2026 refocusing/pause of OSE-230 and CLEC-1, was followed by weakness that Biomed Impact had predicted ('Le titre devrait réagir plutôt négativement'). IDMC 'continue' recommendations have not produced large moves.
evidence.why_not_priced: Largely telegraphed: the February release already carried the October IDMC date, and French retail forums were counting down the days ('Toujours pas de futilité à 10 jours de la fin du T3', Boursorama forum, 21 Sep — opinion, not evidence). What the market does not yet have is a formal re-dating. Only that residual is sized.
evidence.independence: Biomed Impact 3 Mar 2026 independently records the Q3 futility timing: https://www.biomed-impact.com/post/commentaire-ose-immuno-03-03-2026. Nothing independent confirms the slip itself.

evidence.text: ARTEMIA Phase 3 interim futility outcome at the October 2026 IDMC review. A binary of the whole thesis with sign unknown, easily +/-20-40% when it lands.
Combi-TED Phase 2 topline (Tedopi plus nivolumab or docetaxel, 2L NSCLC), ESMO rapid oral on 25 Oct 2026, abstract 2661 RO. The data were not disclosed in the 23 Sep release.

A larger equity raise ('global financing strategy') that Biomed Impact expected within 3-6 months of 28 May. It may coincide with the H1 print but has no date; sized inside finding 1's band, not added separately.
Q3 2026 cash position, calendared for 27 Oct 2026.

EIB tranche repayment or rescheduling in July 2026: no filing and no press item found (web search, French and English).

evidence.text: This release is structurally unlikely to carry a guidance change. Meanwhile the stock has risen 48% from 35.0p (12 Aug) to 51.75p. The implied bar has therefore moved above the company's own guide, and the most likely release (reiteration, Q1 'in line with upgraded expectations') is the setup this name has sold in both previous Septembers.

By contrast, releases that carried a new upgrade rose: Feb 2026 interims 'materially ahead' +13.5%, Dec 2025 +28.3%, Aug 2026 +11.1%. The sign is decided by whether the guide moves. evidence.why_not_priced: If the market were pricing a plain reiteration, the stock would sit near the post-upgrade level of about 42-43.5p (18-28 Aug closes) plus some credit for the framework. Instead it is at 51.75p, about 20% higher, with no new guidance. That gap is either a bet on a further upgrade or 'further colour' at the finals, or momentum. On a two-analyst, $0.33m/day AIM name with no disclosed short, nobody is positioned to lean against it. The caveat is that this reading overlaps the run-up (the free control), which is why it is sized small.
evidence.independence: The reaction pattern comes from the issuer's own prior finals (FY25 finals current-trading wording: https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/made-tech-group--mtec/final-results/9127402) and the price path from the Yahoo tape in the baseline. baseline.priced_lean_basis: Sum of the components above. English coverage frames AOC as an activist building a stake, not as an insider in the pre-results window. The positive lean (+3.18) comes from the short register, not from this.

consensus.basis: Sell-side coverage, carried because it is the measurable proxy for this stage's thesis. Phase 1 measured 1-2 analysts below $1m/day of turnover, 5-7 at $1-5m, 11-13 at $5-25m and 16-19 above, consistently across all three markets. eu_resolve.py ranks the hunt BY this band so the thesis is tested rather than selected on.

history.source: TradingView last/next release dates, stepped backwards
history.caveat: Dates are ESTIMATED by stepping the measured cadence gap backwards from the vendor's last release date; the move is the largest within +/-2 trading days of that estimate. Use it as a SCALE for how far this name travels, never as evidence about a particular past date -- TRT was ranked, traded and never reported on exactly this mistake. positioning.basis: absent from a register that downloaded successfully, so no disclosed net short position at or above the 0.5% public threshold. expected_move.basis: the larger of (a) the median of this name's prior reactions and (b) a one-session move implied by 20-day realised volatility. It is NOT an option-implied move: nothing is paying for it and it carries no information about what the market expects from THIS print. It is a scale for how far this name travels. Phase 1 median realised move was 2.81% (UK), 3.12% (DE), 4.19% (FR) against Japan's 2.87%, with the tail intact in all three -- 42%, 27% and 52% maxima and no price limit to truncate them.

evidence.text: The FactSet dividend consensus of 3.53 SEK (+18% year on year) sits above what the board has done. It has stepped the dividend +0.20 SEK a year (2.60, 2.80, 3.00) and paid 46% then 43% of earnings. At the last two year-ends it came in under FactSet: 2.80 vs 3.12 in 2024 and 3.00 vs 3.23 in 2025. On FY EPS of about 7.8, a 43% payout is about 3.35 and the step pattern gives 3.20.
evidence.reaction_history_on_this_line: Both previous dividend misses came on down days: 2024-10-01 -2.97% and 2025-10-01 -4.76%, from the Yahoo daily tape. Both days also had flat or negative bookings, so the dividend's share of the fall cannot be separated out.
evidence.why_not_priced: The consensus itself shows the sell-side has not adjusted: it sits at 3.53, higher again, after two straight misses. If the market had discounted it, the Swedish preview would carry a figure near 3.2-3.3. The yield impact is small (about 0.2 points of yield), so this is sized small.
evidence.independence: The 2024 miss is a separate Finwire article (https://www.placera.se/telegram/skistars-resultat-blev-samre-an-vantat-i-fjarde-kvartalet-hojer-utdelningen-2024-10-01). The dividend history of 2.60/2.80/3.00 comes from the Yahoo dividend events feed (https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/SKIS-B.ST?range=10y&interval=1mo&events=div). Payout ratios of 46% and 43% are in the issuer's year-end releases (https://view.news.eu.nasdaq.com/view?id=b88515114714cf8f7aaae14b41f6abf7b&lang=sv&src=listed). Caveat: 3.53 is only 45% of FY EPS of about 7.8, inside the 40-60% policy, so a dividend meeting consensus is possible.

evidence.text: The group booking status for winter 2026/27 will be published for the first time since June's +3%. The only update since then was Sälen alone at +10%, in a Swedish-only, non-regulatory release that left out the group figure. So I expect the group between +3% and +6%: the strongest year-end reading in three years, but below the '10%' headlines.
evidence.reaction_history_on_this_line: Year-end booking readings: +/-0% (2024-10-01, stock -2.97%) and -2% (2025-10-01, -4.76%). June 2026's +3% came with an operating-profit beat and the stock rose 9.1%. The 17 Aug 2026 Sälen +10% release moved it +1.85%.
evidence.why_not_priced: Sälen +10% is public and was worth +1.85%. Since the 26 August high of 172.3 the stock has fallen to 159 (-7.7%) with no sourced cause, so the enthusiasm has largely unwound. What is not priced is the group number itself. Two things pull against the headline: the company chose to disclose only Sälen, and Nordea said 2025/26 had an 'optimal' Christmas calendar, which makes that part of the comparison hard. Early Easter 2027 pulls the other way. Net, a small positive.
evidence.independence: Q3 release +3% group (https://view.news.eu.nasdaq.com/view?id=bd3460c443e31657d2e451f82c60fa7fc&lang=sv&src=listed). evidence.text: The Q4 sales consensus of 276 MSEK (+22% year on year) looks to assume property sales. Management said in June that the property market was still hesitant and that there had been no property-sale gains in the first nine months. Last year FactSet also overestimated Q4 sales (256 vs 226 actual) for the same reason.
evidence.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2025-10-01: sales missed by 11.7% while operating profit beat by 7 MSEK. The stock fell 4.76%, but bookings and the dividend also disappointed that day, so this line cannot be isolated.
evidence.why_not_priced: The consensus still carries +50 MSEK of Q4 sales growth. Q4 is the low season, and the market reads it through the operating line, bookings and the dividend, so this is sized small. No property sale was announced June-August on the Nasdaq Nordic feed or in the press room.
